table_rule: For each layer and output column, store 1.05 times the maximum absolute floating-point output over all rows of the 600 existing training calibration records.
selection_rule: Select the smallest global candidate that produces zero output quantizer clipping on the integer reference for every training calibration record across all 12 layers.
validation_rule: Write and freeze the training result before opening validation tensors. Evaluate the one selected factor once and report all results. Validation results do not feed factor selection.
